builds.caption: a real run of assay on a live page
builds.tagline: An agent-native QA CLI for web pages. Deterministic, no tests to write, no LLM.
builds.home_tagline: An agent-native QA CLI for web pages. Deterministic, no tests to write, no LLM.
features: Discovers every control the page renders and works out a test plan from it
Exercises clicks, typing and navigation in a real Chromium and reports where the page contradicts itself
Fully deterministic, with a median run time of 14s
Comes with a skill for 15 coding agent harnesses and a plugin for Claude Code and the DeepSeek Harness

builds.home_tagline: My portfolio site, a static site with no dependencies that's built from plain data files.
features: A contributions ledger that only draws the rows on screen, so it stays fast with thousands of merged pull requests
A builds page that only runs the previews you're looking at, so it stays light however many builds it lists
No framework, just plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with a Python standard-library build script
